snippet.title: GlitchSPANKR Trailer | Six One Indie Showcase: May 2025
snippet.description:
Rescue your game from an insane virus in this comedic narrative driven exploration game! Befriend or destroy him, tackle challenges and minigames, uncover secrets, unlock customizations, and explore different endings. With GlitchSPANKR's antivirus, every level is different and unexpected!

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2727660/GlitchSPANKR/

Visit https://www.sixoneindie.com/showcase for more information.
